lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: And what do ya see him do next? Tell me again.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: That he had the key in his hand but then he dropped it ta answer the phone.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: And then he walked into the living room and sat down by the computer and talked ta whoever was on the phone.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Where did he drop the key?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he ever pick it up?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Who was he talking to on the phone?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: On November 2nd you were over at his house. What were you guys talking about that day?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Well, he was asking me what my future plan was.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did you talk about Teresa at all?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Come on, you just, you just killed a girl and you didn't talk about it at all? I don't believe that. You told me he was gonna get rid of that key. What was he gonna do with the key? Why did he go get the key that day?
